name: lumina-umay-booking
description: Lumina Umay Tarot Booking & Payment System

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { const d = './dist/src/server/db'; fs.mkdirSync(d, { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('./src/server/db/schema.sql', d + '/schema.sql'); const t = './dist/src/server/templates'; fs.mkdirSync(t, { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('./src/server/templates', t, { recursive: true }); if (fs.existsSync('./src/client')) { const c = './dist/src/client'; fs.mkdirSync(c, { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('./src/client', c, { recursive: true }); } })"
